transcript.text: Alright, let's get the package-lock routine started for the 'Midnight Arcade' delivery package. I need signoff from rights, post-production, and publicity before I can give final approval. Can each department review the current draft package — worldwide delivery, standard music credit, 4K UHD 24 fps master, English subtitles, June 14 publicity release — and report any required changes?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I reviewed the countersigned music license this morning, and there are two issues with the current draft package. First, the license restricts distribution to the United States and Canada only — it does not permit worldwide delivery. Second, the required credit is exactly 'Music licensed courtesy of Northline Songs,' not the studio's standard music credit. I haven't entered the countersigned terms into the delivery tracker yet because the rights database migration is still open.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to report a required change from post-production. I received the broadcaster's completed ingest test today and confirmed that delivery must be an IMF package at 25 fps with English SDH captions. The current draft package lists a 4K UHD 24 fps master and ordinary English subtitles, which will fail the partner's ingest specification. The test result is sitting in the post-production test folder pending this routine package-lock meeting.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to report a required change from publicity. I confirmed with the artist's representative this afternoon that publicity for the special is embargoed until June 21, and the representative will reject any public release dated earlier than June 21. So the June 14 publicity release date in the current draft package needs to be changed to June 21 or later. I should note that the approval email is currently attached to the publicity calendar rather than the delivery tracker, if anyone needs to reference it.
